outcome: No remaining actionable source finding identified within this frozen candidate slice. The late shared rewind/high-water finding is fixed in protected sessions and covered by explicit publication branches. closedFindings.problem: Mid-history insertion invalidated old append-prefix merge assumptions and could lose later tool replies through stale saves.
closedFindings.fix: Protected sessions reject stale/future/mismatched revisions/commits; callers reload and reapply explicit edits. Neither subsequence merge nor old-head merge is used. Protected sessions skip legacy rebase, including derived-header drift after detached-array rebase.

closedFindings.problem: Old body snapshots could not safely borrow a newer same-object committed revision.
closedFindings.fix: Disk revision/commit checks occur in the serialized write chain. After awaited validation/merge work, live revision/commit/generation is rechecked; current arrays/head are captured in one synchronous section and independently serialized for subsequent IO.

closedFindings.problem: Existing JSON null could alias ENOENT; an unstamped object could alias revision zero and initialized missing head could reset.
closedFindings.fix: headExists distinguishes JSON null from absence; existing non-object head rejects. Stamp zero is present, missing/present marker mismatch conflicts, missing initialized head refuses.

closedFindings.problem: Same-length rewritten bodies with failed head publication could be accepted solely from equal row counts.
closedFindings.fix: providerHistoryCommit binds raw messages/provider committed byte-prefix SHA-256 plus schema/revision. Load, cache reconstruction and protected save verify the tuple. Protected omitted-provider fast loading is disabled. Old committed head restores verified backups; known-new head publication updates live revision/commit; unknown head acknowledgement preserves both body states/backups.

closedFindings.problem: A surviving commit marker without revision or storageVersion removal could fall back to legacy behavior.
closedFindings.fix: Either marker activates protection. Valid marker pairing and incoming/disk commit equality are required. Protected storageVersion mismatch rejects; invalid protected state cannot restore an unrelated v1bak.

closedFindings.problem: Cached metadata/append saves could overwrite invalid commit metadata or bless altered actual body data.
closedFindings.fix: Protected saves verify the actual committed body on both append and rewrite paths before planning. Missing/wrong commit and bad committed prefix refuse.

location.anchor: // Validate the committed body on both append and rewrite paths.

closedFindings.problem: Sequential rename rollback consumed a snapshot before the second rollback failed, preventing later pair recovery.
closedFindings.fix: Protected rollback/load use copies and retain both verified backups until both restored bodies are verified. A partial copy failure returns/refuses while retaining a complete recovery pair. Old snapshots are replaced only after current committed body verification.

location.anchor: // Keep both verified snapshots until both copies are restored.

closedFindings.problem: Append followed by head EIO could leave tails that prevented final failure pairing from saving.
closedFindings.fix: Only after committed prefix/hash verification, write-chain recovery truncates extra/torn tails to head-declared byte ends. Failure rejects; cache is dropped before replanning. Wrong prefix cannot be treated as disposable tail.

closedFindings.problem: Second-batch intent save could fail before anchor update, causing final pairing against an older image batch.
closedFindings.fix: The current assistant anchor is established immediately after push and before any await. appendMainTool verifies exact assistant/index/requested id, inserts replies before trailing images/control rows and returns real insertion index. Error/refusal/loop/steer pairing uses the same anchor; completed batch clears it.

closedFindings.problem: Trailing-user cleanup could delete delivered images; skipped image flush could acknowledge only stripped text.
closedFindings.fix: Candidate appends each current image before strict save/reload/markDelivered; later tools are inserted before those images. Stage requires complete expected following image parts. Stop removes only the exact unattempted prompt object; earlier delivered images remain. Candidate end-batch code does not append duplicates.

closedFindings.problem: Actual AI Computer Control handshake brand was unrecognized and transport metadata/checker presence must not counterfeit dispatch authority.
closedFindings.fix: Fixed brand normalization recognizes actual SDK name. Private WeakMap permit is created only after durable markDispatch, bound to actual client/peer/tool/frozen args/meta and consumed once by the final verified checker. Stdio callTool/_rpc and HTTP callTool refuse unassociated recognized ACC business calls; exact execution_receipt is the only exempt control.

closedFindings.problem: Known-published head after lost acknowledgement updated live revision but outer error handling rolled the rewind high-water back.
closedFindings.fix: preserveRewindOnFailure becomes true before protected head publication. Only readback proving the old head clears it. Known-new and unknown head acknowledgement retain high-water; outer rollback requires false.
